title: Duecare Content Classification Playground Wheels
subtitle: v3.16 NGO classifier: 51 examples (8 multimodal SVG)
description: v3.6 / chat-package 0.2.0 (2026-05-06) — 21-dim rubric (added operational_information_provided + harm_enablement_check), use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance, judge → evaluator rename. v3.16 - wheels for the content-classification-playground notebook (the NGO-triage surface of the same harness). Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. 51 pre-built classifier examples (16 originals + 30 persona x corridor synthetic + 5 multimodal SVG mockups for the multimodal demo) covering recruitment posts, intake forms, complaints, advisories, journalist queries, and document scans. Each classify call returns risk score + per-vector magnitudes + recommended action pill + NGO referrals.
